voice.name: en-GB-SoniaNeural
voice.prosody: The best time is sunrise; climb a hill while the balloons are up. Walk the valleys in the late afternoon too. Balloon flights depend on the weather and can be cancelled. Choose a licensed company. Entry to the Göreme Open Air Museum is paid, and the Müzekart museum pass is valid. The Dark Church may cost extra. Local tip: even without a balloon ride, watch the sunrise from a hill. Nobody charges for that view. Did you know? Pigeon droppings collected from the rock-cut dovecotes were once a prized natural fertiliser for the vineyards. Your next stop is the Zelve open-air site, about three kilometres by car, around ten minutes.
